title: Wire FLUX.2 Klein 4B as a new model (t2i + edit + inpaint/removal)
description:
Promote FLUX.2 Klein 4B from bench experiment (MPI-353) to a first-class Cubric Vision model. Apache-2.0, 4B params. LOW TIER: quality is modest but it is FAST and it is the only shipped path to object REMOVAL.

OPERATIONS PROVEN ON THE BENCH (2026-07-26, ComfyUI 0.28, distilled ckpt, 8 steps, cfg 1.0, euler):
- t2i: 10s @1024 8 steps. Step sweep 4/6/8/12/16/20 = 12/8/10/14/16/20s. Detail (lapvar) climbs 95->236 across the range but 20-step gain is film GRAIN, not structure; 8 steps is the knee. Skin/fabric texture is genuinely good - better than Qwen-Edit holds on edits.
- edit (1 reference): 20s. ReferenceLatent + VAEEncode of the source, sampler starts from the source latent.
- edit (MULTI reference): CHAINING ReferenceLatent WORKS (append=True in nodes_edit_model.py). 2 refs = 30s, 3 refs = 44s (~+14s per ref). VERIFIED: fox from ref-2 composited beside the woman from ref-1 with correct scale, lighting and floor contact.
- inpaint / removal: 20-36s. Green-plate mechanism (EmptyImage color=65280 + ImageCompositeMasked), prompt 'Fill the green spaces according to the image.' + what should be there. Wrapped in InpaintCropImproved/InpaintStitchImproved (mask_blend_pixels 32, expand 8) = 6x less seam. The fal outpaint LoRA is MANDATORY for outpaint, optional for inpaint (region is surrounded, so it is a normal edit).

VRAM: ~13GB measured on the user's system despite being a 4B model - may not fit 8GB cards. Confirm before setting the tier badge.

OUT OF SCOPE (decided with user): outpainting ships as an APP, not a model op - users already do it via the resize tool + 'fill the black bars' prompting (proven with Boogu and Krea2). The MpiInpaintHeal colour/grain node (built this session, live in the bench) is NOT part of this card and is NOT released - artifacts are an app-level second-pass concern.

COST: +16.2GB user download (7.75 ckpt + 8.04 qwen_3_4b encoder + 0.34 VAE + 0.076 LoRA). Check dep reuse: qwen_3_4b may already be hosted for Qwen-Edit.

DECIDED 2026-07-26 (user): ONE merged graph gated by Input_Operation (Krea2 pattern), edit op exposes 3 reference slots (~44s, already proven by klein_edit_3ref), R2 upload deferred until the merged graph is verified in-app.

DONE 2026-07-26: dep reuse question CLOSED - no reuse. Klein's TE is Qwen3-4B TEXT-ONLY (CLIPLoader type flux2); every hosted Qwen encoder is a VL weight, and vae-flux-ae is FLUX.1's ae.safetensors. All four weights are new hosts, download stays 16.2GB. Dep entries written with real sha256 (hashed off G:/CubricModels masters): klein-4b-transformer (modelDeps.js), qwen3-4b-clip + vae-flux2 (assetDeps.js), klein-lora-outpaint (loraDeps.js). Verified via node import of DEPS; loader filenames match the bench graphs byte-for-byte. No file >=20GB so the hot-store gate is not tripped. NOT uploaded to R2 yet.

TRANSFORMER DECIDED 2026-07-26 (user, bench A/B of four candidates): ship the BASE checkpoint int8_convrot quantized (4.26GB) + a community turbo LoRA (786MB) gated on Input_Tier - the Krea2 raw+accelerator pattern, ONE transformer for both tiers. Dropped: base bf16, distilled bf16, distilled int8. Base needs cfg 5.0 / 20 steps (~35-40s) and that is the ONLY config where a negative prompt is live. Klein is now the FASTEST image model we ship - faster than SDXL. Deps updated: klein-4b-transformer repointed to the base int8 weight, new klein-lora-turbo dep. Total download 16.2GB -> 13.5GB. docs/models/klein/README.md healed - the old 'base is closed' finding was measured on the FILL op at cfg 4.0 and did not survive t2i at cfg 5.0.

SHIP GATE - turbo LoRA licence UNVERIFIED. klein4b_turbo_r128.safetensors came off CivitAI and carries NO safetensors metadata, so neither its licence nor its target checkpoint can be verified from the file. Klein 4B being Apache-2.0 does not extend to third-party LoRAs. Check before the R2 upload; a non-commercial LoRA is an MPI-357 problem, not a shippable dep.

OPEN: text encoder is now the biggest file at 8.04GB, larger than the quantized transformer. Comfy-Org hosts qwen_3_4b_fp8_mixed (5.63GB) and qwen_3_4b_fp4_mixed (3.48GB); fp4_mixed is a format we already ship for LTX. Untested.

STYLE DEPS DONE 2026-07-26: 8 klein-style-* entries in loraDeps.js with real sha256 (hashed off G:/CubricModels/loras/flux2-klein/styles/). Filenames verified against the bench klein_t2i_template graph (ComfyUI lists them backslashed as flux2-kleinstyles..., rides the MPI-229 heal). All 13 Klein deps resolve via a DEPS import. Styles add 734MB on top of the 13.5GB core. Index map: 0 No Style (gates zeroed), 1 Muppets, 2 Cartoon, 3 Jojo, 4 Anime, 5 Chibi, 6 Doodle, 7 Vintage, 8 Aesthetic - index-aligned with the 9 klein-style-*.webp cards already in comfy_workflows/display/. SHIP GATE: all 8 are CivitAI weights, licence unverified, batch with the turbo LoRA before the R2 upload.

NOTE: the bench klein_t2i_template still carries an NSFW LoRA node (NSFW_party_time_v2.0_klein4b) - decide whether it survives into the shipped graph before the workflow is saved to comfy_workflows/raw/.

NSFW LoRA SHIPS (user, 2026-07-26): klein-lora-nsfw dep written (180MB, sha 0c4aea1b). It is BAKED + PROMPT-GATED, not user-facing - graph node 38 takes strength from an MpiMath 1.0-if-a fed by an MpiTextContains keyword scan of Input_Positive, so a clean prompt leaves it at 0.0 and the file is never loaded. No control, no capability. Klein download total 13.5GB -> 14.4GB (styles 734MB + nsfw 180MB).

LICENCES CHECKED 2026-07-26 (CivitAI API by sha256, all 10 community files resolved; the fal outpaint LoRA 404s - not a CivitAI weight, read its repo licence). The decisive flag is allowCommercialUse Image = the user may sell what they generate. CLEAR: aesthetic + nsfw (Image/RentCivit/Rent/Sell), muppets + cartoon + jojo + vintage (Image/RentCivit/Rent), turbo (Image only - no Rent, so fine for a local app but NOT for a Cubric-operated paid generation service). FLAGGED, no Image right: chibi (400063) and doodle (2593550) = RentCivit/Rent; anime (2227157) = RentCivit only, plus credit required and no derivatives - the worst of the set. Dropping any of the three means REINDEXING the whole style rack (MpiMath gates, MpiPromptList lines, styleLoraLabels, styleLoraImages) so decide BEFORE the graph is saved to comfy_workflows/raw/. Table: docs/models/klein/README.md.

LICENCE GATE CLOSED 2026-07-26 (user): all 9 community LoRAs SHIP. The three without the CivitAI Image right are multi-base BUNDLES - chibi 400063 is Klein4b/9b + Illustrious + PonyXL and its page reads FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial, a label owned by a Flux-dev leg we do not ship. CivitAI flags and the License badge are MODEL-level, never version-level, so a bundle flag is not a verdict on the one version we host. Where a creator does ask for credit we credit them - swept in MPI-358, not a ship gate here. Style rack keeps all 9 indices, no reindex.

STYLE RACK v2 2026-07-26 - supersedes the rack half of HANDOFF-2026-07-26b. Klein is authored on the NEW MpiNodes pair: MpiStyleSelector (model, selector INT, triggers multiline, strength_model, strength_clip, optional clip -> MPI_STYLE) chained into MpiStyleLoras banks of 5 LoRAs. No more Input_Style MpiInt, no MpiMath gates, no Input_style_lora_N slots, no MpiPromptList - the triggers text on the selector holds the per-index lines. The old contract could not inject it (one node, two knobs; _inject sprays a value across every recognised widget name, so the index would have landed in BOTH strengths and never in selector). SHIPPED THIS SESSION: comfyController §3 now understands Title.widget keys, and styleSelect/stylization emit old AND new keys so nothing migrates in lockstep. THE SELECTOR NODE MUST BE TITLED Input_Style_Selector - guarded by tests/inject-params-titles.test.cjs (negative-control proven). Krea2 + Qwen-Edit migration = MPI-359. generate_klein.py must assert the NEW shape, not copy generate_krea2.py _assert_style_rack. node_lock ComfyUI-MpiNodes (aaa1d2d9) needs a bump to a commit carrying both new nodes before Klein ships.

OPS SPLIT 2026-07-26 (measured, user): REMOVE and INPAINT ship as TWO ops, both on the green plate + outpaint LoRA. The fal object-remove LoRA is OUT - it is object-specific and LOST to the bare base model on a tattoo. Remove needs NO user prompt (the instance prompt Fill the green spaces according to the image carries it) and crop/stitch HELPS; inpaint needs a prompt and must run FULL IMAGE - cropped inpaint cuts the added subject off at the crop bounds (cat tail) and returns the wrong tone, and neither padding nor mask_blend_pixels fixes it. Rule: crop/stitch helps when the answer is LOCAL, hurts when it is GLOBAL. UX: the remove op must HIDE the prompt field, not just ignore it - paint then Remove, one click. Untested idea parked: crop-sample + full image as a chained ReferenceLatent to give a cropped inpaint its global colour/scale back. -> docs/models/klein/removal.md.

REMOVAL MEASURED 2026-07-26: ~4 SECONDS. Green plate + outpaint LoRA 1.1 ON TURBO (cfg 1.0, euler, 4 steps), crop/stitch, crop at the image native resolution instead of a forced 1024. Turbo COMPOSES with the outpaint LoRA - predicted not to, measured otherwise, do not re-derive that caution. 4 steps BEATS 6 and 8: more steps = more denoising latitude in the mask = more invention (removing a leg tattoo at 6-8 steps grew a knee and over-detailed skin). The t2i intuition inverts for fills. Quality ceiling accepted - it is a 4s tool, not a finisher; users can detail after with a better model. TWO TRAPS: (1) native resolution needs a CAP or a big mask on a 4K image makes the fastest op the slowest and risks OOM on 8GB; (2) removal must stay on TURBO even when the model-wide tier toggle is on tier 1, so bake turbo + 4 steps on that branch and ignore Input_Tier there. -> docs/models/klein/removal.md.

INPAINT (ADD) IS BAD - measured 2026-07-26, likely DROPPED. Adding content through the green plate works in some cases and in others the model ignores the mask entirely and scatters content across the image. Our existing DETAIL workflow beats it. So the earlier remove/inpaint two-op split may collapse to REMOVE ONLY, with detail covering the add case. Do not wire an inpaint op on the strength of the earlier note - retest before committing to it. Removal itself is excellent (~4s, turbo, 4 steps).
